notes.title: PSYCHO DEAD Big Reveal and Our Thanks to You!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061290/e39592e23b194eb39f789dc9e3e4878c12e3575c.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p]Hi everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you for following and supporting us throughout this journey. It has been two and a half years since we began developing PSYCHO DEAD—a project born from our small team’s love, passion, and determination for the survival horror genre. Every step has been a challenge, but also a step closer to realizing our dream. [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061290/e851b1ae0494323e8e392dce27f0ae8f3dc7387d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061290/1291a522f07a36a82f8a14cf6977b86146f58804.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061290/d2b89172af96281994b952fad12714aba9c453d9.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Now, we’re thrilled to share that the wait is almost over. PSYCHO DEAD will have its major reveal during the Horror Game Awards: Halloween Showcase, and we can’t wait for you to see what we’ve been preparing. We hope this moment excites you as much as it does us, and that the experience we’ve created will meet—and even surpass—your expectations. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay safe,[/p][p]Moon Catalyst[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][/carousel]

notes.title: PSYCHO DEAD is part of ‘Games to Get Excited About Fest 2025’!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061290/a9bd4e07d5887369ffbc68e71e382d1b833c460d.png"][/img]
[b]Thrilled to share that PSYCHO DEAD is featured in Alpha Beta Gamer’s ‘Games to Get Excited About Fest 2025’!
[/b]
It's a showcase designed to respect viewer's time, with 110 indie games showcased in just over an hour. No filler, no cinematic trailers and no paid placements - all games are in the showcase under their own merit. 

Massive thanks to Alpha Beta Gamer for the inclusion!

[b]Games to Get Excited About Fest - Trailer[/b]
